payload.artist_html: N. R. Longrich, N. Bardet, N.-E. Jalil, X. Pereda-Suberbiola, A. Schulp, M. Ghamizi
payload.credit_html: "New information on the morphology and tooth replacement of Xenodens calminechari (Squamata: Mosasauridae), a unique mosasaurid from the Maastrichtian Phosphates of Morocco"
payload.description_html: Rendering of CT scan segmentation of Xenodens calminechari, MHNM.KHG.331 (holotype), left maxilla; Sidi Chennane, Oulad Abdoun Basin, Morocco; Phosphates, Upper Couche III, uppermost Maastrichtian. (A), lateral view; (B), dorsal view; (C), medial view; (D), ventral view; (E), anterior view. Scale = 50 mm.
